changes: New 400 g frozen shell-free mussel-meat dose replaces 1600 g live shell-on mussels with no yield equivalence. Retain all thaw liquid within the authored 850 ml total liquid. Keep dry rice/potato layers; separately time lid removal, temperature/softness check and passive rest. Standard/extended use purchased aged pecorino with unknown rind loss; all frozen parsley/garlic bakes through and all oil/juice is served.
recipes.content_review: Ris och tunna potatisskivor bakas lagrade med musselkött och tomat; skild från omrörd risotto och buljongrik arroz a la tumbada. Skalfri tiella finns i Miria Onestas eget recept https://www.dueamicheincucina.it/2020/06/riso-patate-e-cozze-ricetta-tiella-barese.html . Vår frysta produkt, nya dos 400 g och lagrade pecorino är uttryckliga anpassningar; inget skalutbyte antas.
